annotations.text:
TODAY — tap the rows, it works.

The headline counts down to zero instead of scoring you. Weekly targets moved into their own group, because a 3x-a-week target cannot be late on a Tuesday and should not sit in a list of things that can. The greeting is gone; the FAB that covered a row is gone.

HISTORY / WEEK — the broken grid, fixed.

Today, period rows show a pill and no day cells, so rows do not line up with the M-T-W header and the grid looks like a rendering bug. Here every row keeps the same seven columns: a target row marks the days it was actually done, and carries its tally in the label instead of a floating pill.

COMMITMENT DETAIL — one number, then evidence.

Fifteen stats and thirty undated circles became a single lead figure, a dated twelve-week grid you can actually locate yourself in, and the three actions the screen was missing entirely: edit, pause, archive.

The app currently has no design system — two ColorScheme.fromSeed calls and stock Material 3 defaults. This sheet is the missing layer. The one change with teeth: status colours stop borrowing Material's error red, so a missed day reads as information rather than a validation failure.

INSIGHTS - same numbers, no alarm.

The load warning was full-bleed red, styled exactly like an error. It is advice, so it reads as advice. Momentum stays: recovery time is a headline metric. Shown at full scroll height rather than cropped to 844px - this screen scrolls on device.

Generated prose is gone. Every sentence left here describes current state; nothing claims a pattern across history without the insights engine's threshold gate.
